description: Search approved FirmLedger company records by name or keyword, category, country, city and verified status. Returns a short list (name, category, location, verified flag, tick, confidence score, one-line description) plus the accurate total, for picking the right company before calling get_listing. Use city for places like "Nairobi" and country for "Kenya".

category.description: Category name, e.g. "Fintech". Call list_categories for valid names.

limit.description: Results per page (1-25).. Integer or numeric string, clamped to 1–25.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging (use next_offset).. Integer or numeric string, clamped to 0–10000.

query.description: Company name or keyword (matched against name, tagline, description, tags and city).

verified_only.description: Only ownership-verified records (boolean or the string true/false).

name: search_listings
title: Search FirmLedger listings
